headline: Stored earnings per share look off; release not located
summary_short: NorAm Drilling's stored EPS is NOK 0.98068, versus 0.10 prior quarter and 0.09 a year earlier, a jump large enough that the figure is not treated as reliable and no change is stated.
summary_long: The only shard figure is EPS of NOK 0.98068 from Yahoo's earnings chart. Prior-quarter EPS is 0.10 and prior-year 0.09, roughly a tenfold gap, which suggests a currency or scale mismatch. No revenue, margin or cash figures are on the shard.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data. KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. One WebSearch found only the Q2 2026 summary and a financial calendar entry listing the Q3 report for 2026-11-27, so no Q3 release was available. The Q2 2026 EPS in coverage was $0.10, consistent with the prior-quarter figure, which supports treating the current value as suspect.
